visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit event hall. A man dressed as Mario holds a young girl in a bright pink princess dress; a woman in a green dress and blonde wig stands nearby. They stand before a table featuring a birthday cake with a star on top and the name 'RYLIE'. (2) The camera cuts to two dancers in vibrant pink and yellow outfits performing a high-energy routine on a stage area decorated with white and pink balloons. (3) A magician wearing a striped black and red coat with sunglasses produces a white cockatoo from a flat black folder, while the audience at round tables claps enthusiastically. (4) A young man in a white collared shirt performs impressive stunts while balanced on a very tall unicycle in the center of the hall. (5) Several children in costumes, including a boy in a Demon Slayer haori, play under a large, colorful silk parachute being waved by staff. (6) A performer in a full gray and blue furry wolf mascot suit waves to the camera at the entrance of the venue. (7) The unicycle performer returns, now juggling three white clubs while maintaining his balance high above the floor. (8) An acrobatic team consisting of several men in white shirts performs complex human lifts, hoisting a woman and another man into the air in stylized poses. (9) A large group of guests and performers, many in costumes, gather for a celebratory photo, waving and smiling at the camera. (10) The video fades to a black screen with a copper-colored logo for 'BOLAN STUDIO'.

(3) The beat remains consistent; layers of crowd applause and higher-pitched joyful shouting are mixed in periodically. (4) The track continues with a steady 4/4 dance beat, maintaining its positive and celebratory tone until it fades out smoothly with the final logo.
